name: hermes-agent
description: Nous Research Hermes Agent (autonomous, persistent-memory AI agent) on oci-apps. Messaging gateway (Telegram live, Mattermost scaffolded) backed by claude-superset-api (subscription CLI, no metered key). WG-internal, never public.

agent._comment: Shared git checkout (docker volume cloud-git-gh), mounted by _shared/engine.nix. Mount point is this container's own $HOME/git: getent passwd 10000 -> hermes:x:10000:10000::/opt/data:/bin/sh, so HOME is /opt/data and the tree belongs at /opt/data/git. Read-write: this is an agent's own working directory. An agent that can read the code but cannot edit, commit or push it cannot do the job it exists for, and a read-only working tree fails in a way that looks like a broken checkout rather than a deliberate policy. Every agi container mounts this tree writable.
agent._comment_working_directory: Hermes' main process is an s6-supervised idle holder; the real work arrives as `docker exec`, which starts at the image WorkingDir (/opt/hermes) — outside the checkout. The agent then sees zero repositories and answers as if the code did not exist. Starting it in the tree is the point of mounting the tree.

runtime_packages.apt: jq ripgrep wget curl ca-certificates unzip netcat-openbsd patch procps less

runtime_extra_run: set -eu; ARCH="$(uname -m)"; case "$ARCH" in aarch64|arm64) TOOL_ARCH=arm64 ;; x86_64|amd64) TOOL_ARCH=amd64 ;; *) echo "unsupported architecture: $ARCH" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; GH_VERSION=2.63.2; curl -fsSL "https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/download/v${GH_VERSION}/gh_${GH_VERSION}_linux_${TOOL_ARCH}.tar.gz" | tar -xz -C /tmp; install -m 0755 "/tmp/gh_${GH_VERSION}_linux_${TOOL_ARCH}/bin/gh" /usr/local/bin/gh; rm -rf "/tmp/gh_${GH_VERSION}_linux_${TOOL_ARCH}"; YQ_VERSION=4.44.6; curl -fsSL -o /usr/local/bin/yq "https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/download/v${YQ_VERSION}/yq_linux_${TOOL_ARCH}"; chmod +x /usr/local/bin/yq; gh --version; yq --version
